about.title: About
about.description: The Chamber of Economic Diplomacy of Congo works for sustainable and inclusive economic development by connecting local and international actors.
about.visionText: Making Congo a must-visit economic hub in Central Africa by fostering strategic partnerships and innovation.
about.missionText: Support economic actors in their development through economic diplomacy and capacity building.
about.historyDescription: Since our foundation, we have established an elite network dedicated to the economic prosperity of Congo.
about.leadershipDescription: A team of visionary leaders dedicated to the economic diplomacy of Congo.
about.ctaDescription: Become a member of CDECO and actively take part in the economic development of Congo alongside dedicated business leaders.

president.title: Founding President's Message
president.subtitle: Discover the vision of Mr. Arnold Wesley AKINA, Founding President of CDECO.
president.nationalText: CDECO is dedicated to elevating the commercial relations of the Republic of Congo, promoting national resources, backing local entrepreneurs, and rallying key actors toward creating tangible value, attracting impactful investment, and accelerating economic diversification.
president.intlText: CDECO aims to serve as a high-level strategic interface, facilitating trade and investment flows between Congo, fellow African states, and global partners.
president.valuesTitle: An initiative rooted in our core principles:
president.integrityText: Absolute transparency and high ethical standards across all our discussions and alliances.
president.excellenceText: International standards applied systematically to every project we shepherd.
president.cooperationText: Equitable economic partnerships designed for enduring mutual prosperity.

congo.description: Discover a nation undergoing rapid transformation, boasting modern infrastructure, a world-class deepwater port, and exceptional human talent.
congo.geographyText: Located in the heart of the Congo Basin, the Republic of Congo enjoys an exceptional geographic position that makes it a natural hub for Central African trade.
